proposal_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-C - Final Scientific Evaluation Proposal & Preregistration Specification

MATHEMATICALLY_VERIFIED: Estimand definition: theta_def = E[ max(0, -R_E0,t) - max(0, -R_D2,t) | I_def,t = 1 ].
Causal timing: I_def,t determined strictly at t-1 close (16:00 ET); execution at t open (09:30 ET).
Balance sheet identity: Equity = Assets - Liabilities holds with 0.0000 residual under Decimal oracle.
Host sell-first sequencing eliminates intra-batch cash starvation.
Newey-West HAC bandwidth formula: L = ceil(4 * (N / 100)^(2/9)).
Stationary block bootstrap mean block length: B = ceil(N^(1/3)).
SYNTHETIC_SENSITIVITY: MDE sensitivity: Under sigma_DeltaS = 80 bps/day and VIF_HAC = 1.25, 80% power MDE is 45.4 bps/day at N=30, 37.1 bps/day at N=45, 32.1 bps/day at N=60, and 24.9 bps/day at N=100.
Power curve: For a realistic subtle true effect of Delta S = 20 bps/day, power at N=30 is ~34.8%; power reaches 80% only when N >= 100 or true effect >= 45.4 bps/day.
Defensive day frequency: In typical equity market regimes, defensive triggers occur in 15% to 35% of trading days (38 to 88 days per 252 sessions).
ECONOMIC_POLICY_CHOICE: Secondary return criterion: D2 CAGR >= E0 CAGR - 2.0% (200 bps tolerance). This represents the owner's willingness to pay an annual cash insurance premium, not an asymptotic statistical hypothesis.
Stopping boundary: Halt evaluation if D2 cumulative drawdown lags E0 cumulative drawdown by > 300 bps.
Single-day residual tolerance: Critical alert at $0.0001; Hard-stop at $0.01.
HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Approval of theta_def as primary endpoint (DEC-03).
Approval of 200 bps annual CAGR insurance cost budget (DEC-03).
Approval of 252-session horizon with contingent extension to N_def >= 45-60 if volatility is subdued (DEC-04).
Approval of early stopping criteria and inconclusive result classification policy (DEC-04).

primary_endpoint.name: Paired Defensive Downside Shortfall Reduction
primary_endpoint.null_hypothesis: H0: theta_def <= 0 (D2 provides no downside shortfall benefit during defensive sessions)
primary_endpoint.alternative_hypothesis: H1: theta_def > 0 (D2 statistically significantly reduces downside shortfall)
primary_endpoint.test_type: One-sided paired test with Newey-West HAC standard error and stationary block bootstrap

evaluation_horizon_and_sample_size.contingent_extension_rule: If after 252 trading sessions N_def < 30, evaluation horizon is extended up to a maximum of 504 trading sessions until N_def reaches 30.

secondary_return_criterion.economic_interpretation: Maximum tolerable insurance cost drag incurred by maintaining a 50% cash buffer during defensive regimes.

historical_selection_bias_disclosure.bias_impact: Substantial lookahead and selection bias in historical backtests (2018-2021). Prospective forward evaluation with frozen parameters is mathematically mandatory.

inconclusive_result_policy.conditions: p-value in [0.05, 0.20] with theta_def > 0, OR N_def < 30 at horizon end.
inconclusive_result_policy.consequence: Designated INCONCLUSIVE. No strategy promotion permitted; requires extended data collection.
